notes: Corrected one placement: rule 20 puts the construction-supplied *art* on the written predicate `אֹכֶלֶת`, not on the explicit subject pronoun `אָתְּ`, which that rule names outright and which takes only its own *Thou*. The accepted alignment's reason — that the ASV writes *Thou land art* — is the English word order rule 20 expressly declines to read the clause by.
Unit v002 was decided to the qere, giving a singular `גּוֹיֵךְ` that the ASV's *thy nation* matches; the marginal *nations* is the other reading and is not what the projection carries.
The italic *land* stays `added`: the pronoun already has its English pronoun, so no morpheme licenses the supplied noun.
